description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, False Demise triggers, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it triggers, returning False Demise from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability from step 1.
Repeat.
